name: Card table: sets
description: T + set: the set's display name. xahaucards.table.

data.label: Length
data.description: True length of the name; the rest of the field is NUL padding.

data.label: Set name
data.description: NUL padded to 12 bytes.

name: Card table: set shape
description: D + set: the five rarity blocks the mint rolls a subject from. xahaucards.table.

data.label: Common first id
data.description: First subject id of the common block.

data.label: Common count
data.description: How many common subjects the block holds.

data.label: Uncommon first id
data.description: First subject id of the uncommon block.

data.label: Uncommon count
data.description: How many uncommon subjects the block holds.

data.label: Rare first id
data.description: First subject id of the rare block.

data.label: Rare count
data.description: How many rare subjects the block holds.

data.label: Epic first id
data.description: First subject id of the epic block.

data.label: Epic count
data.description: How many epic subjects the block holds.

data.label: Legendary first id
data.description: First subject id of the legendary block.

data.label: Legendary count
data.description: How many legendary subjects the block holds.

name: Card table: on sale
description: O + set: 1 puts the set on sale. Any other value, or no entry, is closed. Read by the shop only. xahaucards.table.

data.label: Open
data.description: 1 = on sale; anything else = closed.

name: Card table: factions
description: F + set + faction key: the faction's display name. xahaucards.table.

data.label: Length
data.description: True length of the name; the rest of the field is NUL padding.

data.label: Faction name
data.description: NUL padded to 12 bytes.

name: Card table: subjects
description: S + set + subject: the card's name and faction. xahaucards.table.

data.label: Length
data.description: True length of the name; the rest of the field is NUL padding.

data.label: Card name
data.description: NUL padded to 20 bytes.

name: Card table: rarities
description: R + rarity letter (C U R E L): the rarity's display name. xahaucards.table.

data.label: Length
data.description: True length of the name; the rest of the field is NUL padding.

data.label: Rarity name
data.description: NUL padded to 12 bytes.

name: Setting: pack price
description: PRICE: the exact amount the shop accepts for a pack. xahaucards.settings.

data.label: Drops
data.description: Exact pack price. 1 XAH = 1,000,000 drops.

name: Setting: mint budget
description: BUDGET: what the shop forwards to the issuer each pack to pay for its ten emitted transactions. xahaucards.settings.

data.label: Drops
data.description: Forwarded to the issuer per pack. 1 XAH = 1,000,000 drops.

name: Setting: new account allowance
description: NEWACCT: added to a free pack's budget when the recipient's account does not exist yet. xahaucards.settings.

data.label: Drops
data.description: 1 XAH = 1,000,000 drops.

name: Setting: shop account
description: SHOP: the only account whose emitted payment the mint acts on. xahaucards.settings.

name: Setting: claim authority
description: CLAIM: the only account the shop accepts a GRANT Invoke from. xahaucards.settings.

name: Setting: card art domain
description: DOMAIN: the host every card's image URL points at. xahaucards.settings.

name: Attestor roll
description: Accounts that may sign cards, with their slot and display name. xahaucards.attest.

name: Signature allowances
description: SIGS + slot: how many more cards that slot may sign. xahaucards.attest.
